operations.name: state_shape
operations.title: Closed ranked state shape
operations.mission: Expose vocabulary, world count, rank count, and closed query fields.

operations.name: formula_truth
operations.title: Finite formula truth sets
operations.mission: Enumerate exact truth sets for the three declared formulas.

operations.name: belief_worlds
operations.title: Minimal ordinal worlds
operations.mission: Return the minimal-rank worlds without treating rank as probability.

operations.name: belief_entails
operations.title: Belief consequence countermodels
operations.mission: Test target entailment over only the declared minimal-rank worlds.

operations.name: rank_layers
operations.title: Ordinal layer projection
operations.mission: Project complete ordinal rank layers in deterministic order.

operations.name: expansion
operations.title: Expansion consistency
operations.mission: Intersect current belief worlds with the input formula and retain inconsistency.

operations.name: conditioning_revision
operations.title: Conditioning revision
operations.mission: Select minimum-ranked input worlds or expose impossible input.

operations.name: formula_equivalence
operations.title: Extensional equivalence
operations.mission: Compare target and alternate formulas across all finite worlds.

operations.name: contradiction_witness
operations.title: Contradiction partition
operations.mission: Partition worlds between the input formula and its complement.

operations.name: rank_normalization
operations.title: Ordinal normalization
operations.mission: Densify ranks while preserving the declared preorder.

operations.name: natural_revision
operations.title: Natural revision projection
operations.mission: Apply one bounded natural-revision projection.

operations.name: lexicographic_revision
operations.title: Lexicographic revision projection
operations.mission: Apply one bounded lexicographic-revision projection.

operations.name: distance_revision
operations.title: Distance revision projection
operations.mission: Select input worlds at minimum Hamming distance from prior minima.

operations.name: revision_disagreement
operations.title: Revision policy disagreement
operations.mission: Expose natural-versus-lexicographic result disagreement.

operations.name: harper_contraction
operations.title: Harper contraction representation
operations.mission: Represent finite Harper contraction as a world-set union.

operations.name: postulate_checks
operations.title: Bounded postulate audit
operations.mission: Audit bounded success, consistency, and extensionality predicates.

operations.name: interpretation_boundary
operations.title: Interpretation reservation
operations.mission: Represent ordinal semantics without human-belief promotion.

operations.name: adequacy_boundary
operations.title: Adequacy reservation
operations.mission: Represent the absence of observation and calibration evidence.

operations.name: empirical_gap
operations.title: Empirical prerequisite gap
operations.mission: Expose exact missing empirical prerequisites as an open gap.

operations.name: authority_gate
operations.title: Consequential authority gate
operations.mission: Keep identity, consent, rights, and public action closed.

boundary: Bounded same-owner finite synthetic ranked-belief conformance software, documentation, and interactive HTML evidence under shared infrastructure only. It is not empirical GMUT confirmation, production THOS or Freed ID, a measurement of any person's beliefs, identity or consent evidence, professional qualification, legal or cultural authority, Maori authority, affected-party authority, complete privacy or accessibility assurance, exhaustive security, independent reproduction, AGI or ASI evidence, consciousness or personhood evidence, Theory-of-Everything proof, canon, deployment authority, a fundamental law of nature or psyche, or Stage 20 readiness.
